        exact this
      have : (m : ℕ) = 1 := by

        exact this
      omega

        simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hp

        have h1 : (a.val : ℝ) ≥ 0 := Nat.cast_nonneg a.val

          have : (a.val, a.val) = (a.val : ℝ) • (1, 1) := by
            ext <;> ring
          rw [this]
          have h_mem : (1, 1) ∈ ({⟨(0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩, ⟨(1 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)⟩} : Set ℝ²) := by
            simp [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
          exact AffineSubspace.mem_span { (1, 1) } (by exact h_mem)
        exact ⟨h_in, h_span⟩

          rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective]
          · exact Finset.card_univ
          ·
            rintro a b h
            simp only [Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at h
            have : a = b := by
              simp at h
              exact h
            exact this
        rw [h_card]
        exact Finset.ncard_le_card
      calc
        m = (Finset.image (fun (a : Fin m) => (a.val, a.val)) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m))).ncard := by
          rw [h_card]
        _ ≤ ((Finset.product (Finset.range m) (Finset.range m) : Set ℝ²) ∩ ({⟨(0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩, ⟨(1 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)⟩} : Set ℝ²).span ℝ : Set ℝ²).ncard :=

        intro p hp
        simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hp
        rcases hp with ⟨a, rfl, rfl⟩
        have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((m : ℝ) - 1 - (a.val : ℝ)) := by
          have : (a.val : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) - 1 := by
            have : a.val + 1 ≤ m := by

        have h2' : ((m : ℝ) - 1 - (a.val : ℝ)) < (m : ℝ) := by

        have h3 : 0 ≤ (a.val : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg a.val

        exact ⟨h_in, h_span⟩
      have h_card : (m : ℕ) ≤ (Finset.image (fun (a : Fin m) => ((m : ℝ) - 1 - (a.val : ℝ), a.val : ℝ)) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m))).ncard := by
        have h_inj : (Finset.image (fun (a : Fin m) => ((m : ℝ) - 1 - (a.val : ℝ), a.val : ℝ)) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m))).card = m := by
          rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective]

            exact this

          rw [h_card]
        _ ≤ ((Finset.product (Finset.range m) (Finset.range m) : Set ℝ²) ∩ ({⟨(0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩, ⟨(1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩} : Set ℝ²).span ℝ : Set ℝ²).ncard :=
          Set.ncard_mono h_sub
    have h_vert : m ≤ ((Finset.product (Finset.range m) (Finset.range m) : Set ℝ²) ∩ ({⟨(0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩, ⟨(0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)⟩} : Set ℝ²).span ℝ : Set ℝ²).ncard := by
      have h_sub : (Finset.image (fun (a : Fin m) => (0, a.val : ℝ)) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)) : Set ℝ²) ⊆ ((Finset.product (Finset.range m) (Finset.range m) : Set ℝ²) ∩ ({⟨(0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩, ⟨(0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)⟩} : Set ℝ²).span ℝ : Set ℝ²) := by
        intro p hp
        simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hp
        rcases hp with ⟨a, rfl, rfl⟩
        have h1 : 0 ≤ (a.val : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg a.val
        have h2 : (a.val : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_lt (by
            have : a.val < m := Fin.val_lt a
            exact this)
        have h_in : (0, a.val : ℝ) ∈ (Finset.product (Finset.range m) (Finset.range m) : Set ℝ²) := by
          simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range]
          exact ⟨by norm_num, h2⟩
        have h_span : (0, a.val : ℝ) ∈ ({⟨(0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩, ⟨(0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)⟩} : Set ℝ²).span ℝ := by
          have : (0, a.val : ℝ) = (a.val : ℝ) • (0, 1) := by
            ext <;> ring
          rw [this]
          have h_mem : (0, 1) ∈ ({⟨(0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩, ⟨(0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)⟩} : Set ℝ²) := by
            simp [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
          exact AffineSubspace.mem_span { (0, 1) } (by exact h_mem)
        exact ⟨h_in, h_span⟩
      have h_card : (m : ℕ) ≤ (Finset.image (fun (a : Fin m) => (0, a.val : ℝ)) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m))).ncard := by
        have h_inj : (Finset.image (fun (a : Fin m) => (0, a.val : ℝ)) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m))).card = m := by
          rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective]
          · exact Finset.card_univ
          ·
            rintro a b h
            simp only [Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at h
            have : a = b := by
              simp at h
              exact h
            exact this
        rw [h_card]
        exact Finset.ncard_le_card
      calc
        m = (Finset.image (fun (a : Fin m) => (0, a.val : ℝ)) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m))).ncard := by
          rw [h_card]
        _ ≤ ((Finset.product (Finset.range m) (Finset.range m) : Set ℝ²) ∩ ({⟨(0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩, ⟨(0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)⟩} : Set ℝ²).span ℝ : Set ℝ²).ncard :=

    have h_horiz : m ≤ ((Finset.product (Finset.range m) (Finset.range m) : Set ℝ²) ∩ ({⟨(0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩, ⟨(1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩} : Set ℝ²).span ℝ : Set ℝ²).ncard := by
      have h_sub : (Finset.image (fun (a : Fin m) => (a.val : ℝ, 0)) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)) : Set ℝ²) ⊆ ((Finset.product (Finset.range m) (Finset.range m) : Set ℝ²) ∩ ({⟨(0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩, ⟨(1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩} : Set ℝ²).span ℝ : Set ℝ²) := by
        intro p hp
        simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hp
        rcases hp with ⟨a, rfl, rfl⟩
        have h1 : 0 ≤ (a.val : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg a.val
        have h2 : (a.val : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_lt (by

        have h_span : (a.val : ℝ, 0) ∈ ({⟨(0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩, ⟨(1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩} : Set ℝ²).span ℝ := by

          have h_mem : (1, 0) ∈ ({⟨(0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩, ⟨(1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩} : Set ℝ²) := by

      have h_card : (m : ℕ) ≤ (Finset.image (fun (a : Fin m) => (a.val : ℝ, 0)) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m))).ncard := by
        have h_inj : (Finset.image (fun (a : Fin m) => (a.val : ℝ, 0)) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m))).card = m := by
          rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective]
          · exact Finset.card_univ
          ·

            have : a = b := by
              simp at h

        exact Finset.ncard_le_card
      calc

    have h_dist : Distinct (List.mk (({⟨(0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩, ⟨(1 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)⟩} : Set ℝ²).span ℝ : AffineSubspace ℝ ℝ²)
        (List.mk (({⟨(0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩, ⟨(1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩} : Set ℝ²).span ℝ : AffineSubspace ℝ ℝ²)
          (List.mk (({⟨(0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩, ⟨(0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)⟩} : Set ℝ²).span ℝ : AffineSubspace ℝ ℝ²)
            (List.mk (({⟨(0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩, ⟨(1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)⟩} : Set ℝ²).span ℝ : AffineSubspace ℝ ℝ²) [] : List (AffineSubspace ℝ ℝ²)) : List (AffineSubspace ℝ ℝ²)) : List (AffineSubspace ℝ ℝ²)) := by
      refine ⟨fun _ _ h => by
        rcases h with (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩)
        · simp at h1
        · rcases h2 with (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨h3, h4⟩)
          · simp at h3
